scope: Exact current Collections.unzipWords(bytes,uint256) runtime from PC zero through exhaustive fitting two-word raw bytes decoding, actual alignment/lane checks and count arithmetic, physical allocation/calloc, arbitrary finite original-byte lane selection, actual MCOPY and physical dynamic ABI RETURN or exact UnalignedWords/InvalidLane/empty REVERT. Assigned selector, zero value and calldata size four through 2^64-1. Nonpayable/short rejection uses separately checked immutable retained evidence. Other bodies and whole-contract completion remain open.
assumptions: Reviewed canonical runtime/input extraction, complete instruction-boundary scanning and reached EVM opcode interpretation remain trusted. Local destinations are actual instruction boundaries. Faithful CALLVALUE/CALLDATASIZE/CALLDATALOAD, fresh zero memory and adequate reached execution/allocation/stack resources are explicit; no physical gas-sufficiency theorem.

Raw root admits zero value, calldata size four through 2^64-1 and compiler-bound selector b2303db4. Actual decoding partitions all fitting raw frames into accepted or five malformed classes: incomplete two-word head, offset at least 2^64, missing length header, length at least 2^64, truncated payload. Every malformed class physically empty-REVERTs. Every scalar lane Word is admitted at decoding; loose offsets, dirty unused gaps/padding, overlapping empty heads and trailing calldata admitted by the compiler are preserved. Calldata size at least 2^64 is outside the explicit representation premise. Nonzero value/short calldata have separate immutable retained evidence.

Actual remainder/alignment checks yield UnalignedWords(length), before the actual lane check yields InvalidLane(which) for every Word above one. Valid lanes use actual checked division/addition/multiplication paths to derive laneCount=(count+1)/2 for zero or count/2 for one, with input count below 2^59 and laneCount no greater than count. Physical allocation guard, length/free-pointer writes and beyond-calldata zero CALLDATACOPY reach the exact initial lane heap, including both empty-output causes. These bounds follow from actual decoder/body instructions, rather than a fixture cap.

The laneCount-index rank composes arbitrary finite actual checked multiply/add/slice/read and compiled loop paths without fixture/fuel bounds or dropped admitted inputs. Original calldata word 2*i+which is stored at output index i in order; a proved big-endian encode/decode inverse establishes exact original byte-block preservation. Odd counts place the extra word in lane zero. Physical memory frames, rounded expansion, original-image MCOPY, ABI offset/byte length/payload and RETURN/REVERT slices are proved. No allocation or serialization premise substitutes for these reached instructions.

Dafny/Boogie/Z3, solc reproduction, Node/Hardhat/EDR and reviewed scripts are trusted. Every reached included proof needs complete native/CSV/declaration inventories, zero audit, fixed regeneration and tool/source/runtime/dependency closure. One hundred five independent complete EVM receipts and three semantic one-byte faults are required. Each fault needs a baseline-covered native postcondition failure and contradictory complete EVM receipt; timeout, parse/type errors, precondition failures and generation rejection do not count.

No whole-contract bytecode, source-to-whole-bytecode equivalence, gas, deployment, complexity, performance, unrestricted representation or unconditional resource-availability claim. Public coverage updates only after retained evidence and an independent current-source checker pass.
